entry.intro: Oh Hell-style whist for 3 to 7 players: nominate exactly how many tricks you will win.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.full: Full: 7 down to 1 and back (14 rounds)
lobby.instantWinNote: (nominate 7 and win all 7 tricks in the first or last round to win the whole game)
lobby.jokersNote: (the two Jokers are shuffled in: a Joker wins the trick if you lead it or cannot follow suit, unless the other Joker is played in the same trick, when both lose)
lobby.hintsNote: (suggest a nomination for your hand; turn off to work it out for yourselves)
lobby.scoring: Hit your nomination exactly and score 10 plus the number nominated. {rounds} rounds in all.

table.forbiddenTitle: You cannot nominate this as the dealer

status.yourTurnNominate: Your turn: nominate how many tricks you will win.
status.waitingReady: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the next round.
status.roundOver: The round is over: close the scores to carry on.
status.dealerForbidden: You are the dealer, so you cannot nominate {number}: the nominations would total {cards}, the number of tricks, and somebody has to miss.
status.dealerFree: You are the dealer. The others have already nominated at least {cards} tricks between them, so any number is allowed.
status.dealerLast: {name} deals and nominates last: they cannot nominate {number}.
status.followSuit: Dimmed cards cannot be played: you must follow suit.
status.instantHow: They nominated 7 and won all 7 tricks in {round}.

facts.nominatedTotal: {total} of {count} trick nominated | {total} of {count} tricks nominated

final.instantExplain: {name} nominated 7 and won all 7 tricks, so the game ends here whatever the totals. Everyone else is ranked by their scores so far.
final.youWon: Well played: that is a win for you.

log.roundTrumps: Round {n}: {count} card each, {trump} are trumps. | Round {n}: {count} cards each, {trump} are trumps.
log.roundNoTrumps: Round {n}: {count} card each, no trumps. | Round {n}: {count} cards each, no trumps.
log.jokersCancel: Both Jokers were played, so they cancel out.
log.secondJokerWins: The second Joker beats the Joker that led.

errors.lengthSetting: The game is either the full 14 rounds or 7 down to 1.
errors.missPointsSetting: That scoring option must be on or off.
errors.instantWinSetting: That instant win option must be on or off.
errors.jokersSetting: The Jokers option must be on or off.
errors.hintsSetting: The hints option must be on or off.
errors.notTimeToNominate: It is not time to nominate.
errors.notYourTurnToNominate: It is not your turn to nominate.
errors.nominateRange: Nominate a whole number from 0 to {max}.
errors.dealerForbidden: As the dealer you cannot nominate {number}: the total would be {cards}, the number of tricks, so somebody has to miss.
errors.jokerOnlyWhenVoid: You can only play a Joker when you cannot follow suit ({suit}).
